description: The agent's tools whose output the customer's app shows as a component, such as a chart or a card (Project Settings, Judging, Tools shown as UI): their output is not checked as an answer. Returns the saved list, and the tools found in the project's recent traces with how often each was called and whether its name suggests a UI tool. Change the list with set_ui_tools.

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project
